demons''' are the second weakest standard [[demon]], above the [[imp]]. They are sometimes killed by [[free-to-play]] players, as they are one of the [[strongest monsters]] on those servers and can drop the desirable [[rune med helm]]. Lesser demons have a somewhat low [[Defence]], which can make them a good source of combat [[experience]]. They are susceptible to the effects of [[demonbane weapons]]. The [[Chasm of Fire]] is one of the best locations for slaying lesser demons. The fairy ring ({{Fairycode|DJR}}) is very close, and a [[Dwarf multicannon|Dwarf Multicannon]] can be used to speed up the task; players can also [[safespot]] in this location. Although combat experience per hour can be above average, lesser demons' sparse drops make them a below average [[Slayer task]]. A unique [[Lesser demon (Melzar's Maze)|Lesser demon]] can be found in the basement of [[Melzar's Maze]], and is fought during the [[Dragon Slayer I]] [[quest]]. Several graphical variants of lesser demons were added with this update, including making the one in [[Melzar's Maze]] slightly taller than normal and giving him an extended green tongue. *During the [[Grid Master]] event, the first [[lesser demon]] that is killed on the top floor of the [[Wizards' Tower]] would say {{Overhead|Swarm the tower, my brethren}}{{Sic|No punctuation at the end of the sentence.}} when it died, causing several lesser demons to spawn across all floors of the tower.
